name: Jaeger Ojanen
description: A mysterious tiger-man who aids Hazezon, father of Jedit, killed by a sandworm.

description_citations.text: "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit sees Jaeger's medallion on Johan and realizes Johan killed his father; Johan escapes by summoning Beasts of Bogardan and receives a vision from Shauku.
timeline.quote: understands that the tyrant killed his father

citation.text: "Jedit (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's army is stalled at Palmyra by Hazezon and Jaeger and disperses in a magical sandstorm; Jaeger is killed by a sand wurm.
timeline.quote: his army ended up dispersing due to a magical sandstorm conjured by Hazezon .

citation.text: "Johan", section "Johan's War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon finds the tiger man in the Sukurvian Desert and brings him toward Bryce, learning of the prophecy of None, One, and Two.
timeline.quote: when None and One clash, only Two shall remain.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tirras attacks Bryce; Jaeger saves Hazezon and leads the militia in repelling the invaders despite stone-throwing devils.
timeline.quote: led by him, the militia of Bryce repels the invaders, albeit at great cost.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon seals a pact with Beckoner, ending the merfolk attacks on Palmyra.
timeline.quote: Hazezon can seal a pact with Beckoner, shaman of the tribe Born of the Beck.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hazezon summons sand warriors and a huge sandstorm as Tirrans besiege Palmyra.
timeline.quote: the real magic summoned by Hazezon is a huge sandstorm

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sandstorm destroys Johan's army; Jaeger reveals he is the None and fights Johan, who is devoured by a sandworm.
timeline.quote: While the two are fighting, a sandworm leaps out and devours Jaeger.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeger's last words reveal other tiger men in the east, and Johan plans to make them part of his army.
timeline.quote: intends to make them part of his new army.

citation.text: "Johan (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johan's forces attack Bryce; Hazezon, aided by Jaeger Ojanen and his sand warriors, leads the defense and halts the attack.
timeline.quote: The war began when Johan’s forces attacked Bryce

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeger confronts Johan and is killed by a sandworm.
timeline.quote: Jaeger confronted Johan but was killed by a sandworm.

citation.text: "Johan's War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3334 AR, Xira fights at the Battle of Bryce against Hazezon Tamar and Jaeger Ojanen and flees when it turns against her.
timeline.quote: When the battle turned against her, she fled the scene.

citation.text: "Xira Arien", section "The Glass Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
